title: Search continues for 12 missing passengers of fire-hit ferry

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, ORIENTAL MINDORO, Philippines — Search and rescue operations continued Monday, Sept.14 for 12 people still missing after passenger ferry M/V June Aster caught fire off Coron, Palawan, with authorities starting a dewatering operation to search the submerged ship’s lower section. Kristine Mechelle Ablaña, municipal tourism officer of Coron, said in a phone interview that the dewatering operation began around 8 a.m. to remove water from the lower portion of the sunken vessel. Pumps and empty drums were being used to drain the water and expose the ship’s floor, where rescuers hoped to locate the missing passengers, Ablaña said. READ: Palawan ferry […]...
